proposals.workload: Deploy an immutable edge application artifact and expose its declared request interface.
proposals.portableBoundary: Artifact identity, entrypoint, non-secret configuration, declared connections, and observable service identity.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Artifact or immutable execution identity changes may require replacement.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Runtime-local state is outside this Form and must not be implied durable.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete retires the serving identity while preserving host audit evidence.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import requires exact artifact and host resource identity evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports artifact, configuration, connection, and serving-status drift.

securityBoundary.network: The host owns ingress, egress, routing, and isolation policy.
securityBoundary.artifacts: Application bytes are immutable and digest-bound.
securityBoundary.secrets: Secret values never enter portable desired state or provider state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Application, Component, Link, and Action inform the resource model but do not define immutable edge artifacts or request serving.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: System and Machine lifecycle inform generic operations but do not model an edge/event application contract.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Node, artifact, and relationship concepts inform topology without requiring TOSCA orchestration.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: Deployment, Knative Service, and managed-resource reconciliation inform lifecycle and drift.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: Workers, Fastly, and edge-service providers show common artifact, configuration, route, and state boundaries.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A provider-neutral immutable edge application contract with host-owned routing, credentials, placement, and runtime implementation.

proposals.workload: Provision a relational database with a declared engine contract and expose a query interface.
proposals.portableBoundary: Engine family, compatibility version, optional digest-bound schema material, logical database identity, and observable query interface without credentials.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Engine-family changes may require export and replacement.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Delete and migration can destroy durable data without host recovery evidence.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete follows host retention and backup policy and must report retained recovery.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import binds an existing database only with exact engine and ownership evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports engine compatibility, logical identity, schema-material identity, and query-service availability drift.

securityBoundary.credentials: Database credentials remain host-owned and are exposed only through authorized bindings.
securityBoundary.network: The host owns network reachability and isolation.
securityBoundary.artifacts: Database engine artifacts are host implementation details.
securityBoundary.secrets: Passwords and connection secrets never enter portable state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Resource, Storage, Link, and lifecycle actions inform attachment and lifecycle.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: System, Volume, and credential separation inform managed infrastructure boundaries.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Database and DBMS node relationships inform portable requirement and capability separation.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: Database operators and managed-resource APIs inform reconciliation, secret publication, and deletion policy.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: RDS, Cloud SQL, D1, and PostgreSQL providers expose compatibility and state tradeoffs.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A small relational service intent that exposes portable query capability while leaving credentials, topology, and engine implementation to the host.

proposals.workload: Provision durable object storage and expose an authorized object-storage interface.
proposals.portableBoundary: Bucket identity, version-retention semantics, lifecycle behavior, and object interface without backend credentials or provider namespace.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: A host migration may require copy and replacement; version-retention changes remain an explicit workload-semantic update.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Bucket deletion can destroy all objects and requires explicit host safeguards.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete must state non-empty handling and retained recovery policy.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import binds an existing bucket with exact ownership and lifecycle evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports version-retention, availability, and implementation-independent bucket drift.

securityBoundary.network: The host owns endpoint exposure and network policy.
securityBoundary.artifacts: No executable artifact belongs in the Form.
securityBoundary.secrets: Keys and signed URLs never enter portable state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Storage and Link concepts inform attachment but object operations require a distinct interface.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: Volume lifecycle informs durable storage while object semantics remain different.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Object-storage node capabilities inform requirements and relationships.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: ObjectBucketClaim and provider managed buckets inform claim, deletion, and connection publication.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: S3, R2, GCS, and Azure bucket resources expose common lifecycle and policy boundaries.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A backend-neutral object bucket lifecycle paired with an explicit object interface and no credential transport.

proposals.workload: Provision a namespaced key-value store and expose authorized key operations.
proposals.portableBoundary: Namespace lifecycle, broad consistency/capability intent, and key-value interface without backend credentials.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Incompatible consistency or namespace changes may require copy and replacement.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Delete destroys keys unless the host retains recovery evidence.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete follows explicit non-empty and retention policy.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import requires exact namespace ownership and capability evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports namespace and declared capability drift without reading values.

securityBoundary.network: The host owns service reachability and isolation.
securityBoundary.artifacts: No executable artifact belongs in the Form.
securityBoundary.secrets: Stored values and credentials never enter Resource state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Generic Resource and Link concepts apply but do not define key-value semantics.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: CIMI has no focused portable key-value service contract; only generic lifecycle concepts transfer.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Capability and relationship modeling informs consumption of the store.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: Managed KV CRDs and connection-secret patterns inform reconciliation while secret transport is excluded.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: Cloudflare KV and managed cache/provider resources show namespace and state behavior.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A minimal namespaced KV lifecycle and interface that does not standardize a provider's consistency or credential model.

proposals.workload: Provision a durable message queue used by connected producers and consumers.
proposals.portableBoundary: Queue lifecycle, delivery intent, retention limits, and declared messaging interface without selecting a broker.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Delivery or retention changes may require a new queue and drain.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Delete or incompatible migration can discard queued messages.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete must define drain, purge, and retained evidence behavior.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import requires exact broker queue ownership and delivery-semantics evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports queue policy and consumer-binding drift without reading message bodies.

securityBoundary.credentials: Producer and consumer credentials remain host-owned bindings.
securityBoundary.network: The host owns broker endpoints and isolation.
securityBoundary.artifacts: Consumer code belongs to a connected runtime Resource, not the Queue.
securityBoundary.secrets: Message contents and credentials never enter portable state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Resource, Link, and Action inform lifecycle and producer/consumer relationships.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: CIMI has no focused broker-neutral message queue contract.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Messaging queue nodes and relationships inform capabilities and requirements.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: Broker operators, KEDA, and managed Queue resources inform reconciliation and consumer attachment.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: SQS, Pub/Sub, Service Bus, and Cloudflare Queue resources expose delivery and retention differences.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A broker-neutral queue lifecycle and connection contract with explicit but deliberately narrow delivery intent.

proposals.workload: Invoke one connected Resource on a portable recurring schedule.
proposals.portableBoundary: Schedule expression, timezone, and exact target connection without selecting a scheduler.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Expression changes should update in place unless the host cannot preserve identity.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Missed invocations are operational events rather than durable Form state.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete stops future delivery and retains bounded execution audit.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import requires exact scheduler and target identity evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports expression, timezone, target, and delivery-registration drift.

securityBoundary.credentials: Invocation authority remains a host-owned binding.
securityBoundary.network: The host owns delivery transport and reachability.
securityBoundary.artifacts: No executable artifact belongs in Schedule.
securityBoundary.secrets: Invocation credentials and payload secrets never enter portable state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Action and Link concepts inform invocation of a connected Resource.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: CIMI does not define a focused recurring invocation resource.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Policies, triggers, and workflows inform schedule-to-target relationships.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: CronJob and managed scheduler resources inform expression, timezone, and missed-run behavior.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: Cloud scheduler and event-rule resources expose target, retry, and timezone tradeoffs.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A small recurring trigger Resource that connects to another portable Resource without embedding provider event targets.

proposals.workload: Run an immutable OCI image as a long-lived service and expose declared interfaces.
proposals.portableBoundary: Digest-pinned image, non-secret configuration, declared connections, and observable request interface.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Host networking or runtime changes may require replacement; image changes should create a reviewed revision.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Writable local filesystem is not portable durable state.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete retires service instances and preserves host audit evidence.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import requires exact image, service identity, and configuration evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports image, connections, request-interface availability, and service-configuration drift.

securityBoundary.credentials: Registry and runtime credentials remain host-owned.
securityBoundary.network: The host owns ingress, egress, service discovery, and isolation.
securityBoundary.artifacts: The OCI image must be pinned by digest.
securityBoundary.secrets: Secret environment and files never enter portable desired state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Application, Component, Resource, and Link inform service composition.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: Machine and System lifecycle inform compute service operations but not OCI semantics.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Container runtime, software component, artifact, and relationship types are direct prior art.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: Deployment, Service, probes, resources, and rollout reconciliation are direct prior art.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: ECS, Cloud Run, Container Apps, and provider-native container services expose common and divergent fields.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A digest-bound OCI service intent smaller than Kubernetes and independent of one managed container product.

proposals.workload: Run a namespace of addressable stateful entities from immutable application code.
proposals.portableBoundary: Entity namespace identity, digest-bound code, generic entrypoint, runtime and persistence capability requirements, non-secret configuration, connections, and declared invocation interface.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Namespace or storage-model changes require explicit migration and may not permit replacement.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Delete can destroy entity state and requires retention or evacuation policy.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete must drain or evacuate entities and report recovery boundaries.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import requires exact namespace, code, and durable-state ownership evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports code, namespace, runtime, and durable-state availability drift without reading entity data.

securityBoundary.credentials: Invocation and storage credentials remain host-owned.
securityBoundary.network: The host owns routing, isolation, and entity addressing exposure.
securityBoundary.artifacts: Application code is immutable and digest-bound.
securityBoundary.secrets: Entity data and secrets never enter portable Resource state.

priorArt.name: OCCI
priorArt.finding: Resource, Link, and Action inform addressable lifecycle but not stateful entity namespaces.

priorArt.name: CIMI
priorArt.finding: Machine and System do not directly model addressable actor/entity state.

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Stateful components, artifacts, and storage relationships inform deployment boundaries.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: StatefulSet and operator patterns inform identity and storage but not per-entity addressing semantics.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: Durable Object namespaces and actor-runtime resources expose code, namespace, and migration coupling.

proposals.existingAbstractionGap: A portable namespace-level contract for addressable durable entities without standardizing the host's actor runtime or storage engine.

proposals.workload: Provision a vector index with fixed dimensional and metric compatibility and expose an index interface.
proposals.portableBoundary: Dimension, metric family, lifecycle identity, and declared vector-index interface without selecting an engine or embedding provider credentials.

lifecycleRisks.replacement: Dimension or incompatible metric changes require rebuild or replacement.
lifecycleRisks.dataLoss: Delete or rebuild can discard indexed vectors unless export/recovery exists.
lifecycleRisks.delete: Delete follows explicit retention and recovery policy.
lifecycleRisks.import: Import requires exact dimension, metric, namespace, and ownership evidence.
lifecycleRisks.drift: Refresh reports index configuration and availability drift without reading vector contents.

securityBoundary.network: The host owns query endpoint exposure and isolation.
securityBoundary.artifacts: No executable artifact belongs in the Form.
securityBoundary.secrets: Vectors, metadata, and credentials never enter portable Resource state.

priorArt.name: CIMI

priorArt.name: TOSCA
priorArt.finding: Data service capabilities and relationships inform consumption boundaries.

priorArt.name: Kubernetes/Crossplane
priorArt.finding: Managed vector database CRDs and operators inform reconciliation and connection publication.

priorArt.name: Terraform/OpenTofu
priorArt.finding: Pinecone, managed search, and Vectorize resources expose dimension, metric, namespace, and state tradeoffs.
